product_overview: StudyFlow is a study resource sharing platform that helps students discover and share educational materials, collaborate in community discussions, and use AI tools to support learning. It includes authentication, a dashboard, notes browsing, AI tutoring, chat history, and community posting features.
core_goals: Enable students to sign up, log in, and manage access to their study workspace
Help users browse, discover, and share study resources
Provide AI-powered study assistance through tutoring and chat
Support community discussions through posts, comments, and profiles

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can create an account, sign in, request a password reset, and set a new password.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter account details -> Submit the registration form -> See successful account creation and access to the app
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated dashboard
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter email address -> Submit the reset request -> See confirmation that the reset request was accepted
Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter reset token and new password -> Submit the reset form -> See confirmation that the password was updated
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See validation feedback that sign-in failed

features.name: Study Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated users can access the main study workspace and move between study and community sections.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View the main study dashboard -> Open study or community sections -> Continue exploring the workspace
Navigate to /dashboard -> Review the dashboard overview -> Sign out -> Return to the public entry flow

features.name: AI Tutor and Chat
features.description: Users can ask the AI tutor questions, use prompts, and review prior conversations for ongoing study support.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/ai-tutor -> Open the AI tutor workspace -> Enter a question -> Submit the message -> See an AI response
Navigate to /dashboard/ai-tutor -> Open the AI tutor workspace -> Choose a suggested prompt -> Submit the prompt -> See a generated answer
Navigate to /dashboard/ai-tutor -> Start a conversation -> Send a follow-up message -> Continue the same thread with contextual replies
Navigate to /dashboard/chatbot -> Open chat history -> Review past conversations -> Resume a previous discussion

features.name: Notes Browsing and File Uploads
features.description: Users can browse available study notes, search or select a note, and upload supported study files.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/browse-note -> Browse available notes -> Select a note to inspect -> Review the note contents
Navigate to /dashboard/browse-note -> Search for a note -> Choose a matching result -> Open the selected study note
Navigate to /dashboard/browse-note -> Upload a supported study file -> Wait for the upload to complete -> See the file added for study use

features.name: Community Discussions
features.description: Users can browse community posts, create new posts, view post details, comment on posts, and open author profiles.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/community -> Browse community posts -> Open a post -> View the post details
Navigate to /dashboard/create-post -> Enter post information -> Publish the post -> See the new post available in the community
Navigate to /dashboard/post -> Read a post -> Add a comment -> See the comment appear in the discussion
Navigate to /dashboard/community -> Browse posts -> Open an author profile -> View the author's contributions and profile information
